chapters.title: Chapter 51 Lin Cui is the deputy director
paragraphs: When I came to the office, Lin Cui was also in the office. The teacher's office was very large, like a hall, and there were glass partitions on both sides, which were considered subject offices. According to the different courses taught by teachers, basically teachers in one area only teach one course.

Lin Cui was a little surprised to see her man come to the office, but her expression did not change. Some teachers around her also congratulated her because there was a rumor that Lin Cui would be promoted to the position of deputy director of teaching, and her salary would immediately soar to 10,000. She had worked in an ordinary teaching position for more than ten years, and now she had crossed the threshold of positive and negative group leaders and excellent class teachers. She came directly to the position of deputy director. It would be a lie to say that there was no trick behind this, but looking at the attitude of the principal towards Lin Cui, it didn't seem like there was an affair, but it seemed like a blow from a higher dimension.

Lin Cui had known for a long time that she would be promoted to the position of deputy director of teaching. She only needed to wait until the meeting next week to announce it. Now it was a prelude, and she had to adapt first. She knew that all this was given by her man and her students. She could get more by following her students, and she was happy to serve Zhao An and treat him like her husband. Recently, Lin Cui has learned how to put on makeup, and bought some bright red high heels and stockings as a match.

This change made her a little shy, but she knew Zhao An's hobbies, he liked mature women, and he also liked high heels and stockings with beautiful feet. Lin Cui has always been very concerned about the maintenance of her jade feet, which is her capital to keep Zhao An.

"Teacher Peng, what's wrong with you? Why are you so angry, Zhao An, did you do something wrong?" Lin Cui walked over in high heels and asked with a smile, seemingly asking, but actually favoring her man. Her vagina was conquered, and her heart was also conquered by Zhao An, otherwise she would not allow him to ejaculate into her body every time, that is what a husband can do.

"Hmph, Deputy Director Lin, Zhao An instigated classmates to fight, look how he beat this classmate. You say that he instigated others to fight at such a young age, won't he commit a crime in the future? This is not okay, he must be educated properly, call his parents over, it's too outrageous, what kind of bitter hatred is there between these classmates?" Peng Ze began to believe his nephew's one-sided words.

And Peng Ze's performance made Zhao An sneer at the corner of his mouth, and he didn't care how the other party smeared him. He didn't have any impression of Peng Ze in the first place. An old man who was about to retire, now actually jumped out and wanted to step on him to satisfy his vanity? Sorry, you're going to be beaten!
After seeing the man's smirk, Lin Cui silently mourned for the old teacher Peng Ze in her heart. It was estimated that it would not be so easy to end if she provoked her man.
"What happened? Let's first ask about the origin of the incident."

"Hmph, I saw them beating people, could it be fake?" Peng Ze felt a little embarrassed. He seemed to realize that he was a little rash, and he didn't seem to ask why he started to blame Zhao An. But things had come to this point. If he admitted his mistake, would he still be able to work in the department office? Wouldn't he be laughed at by his colleagues?

Even the principal was alarmed by this matter. He was going to see where he could go on a public trip today, but he saw this kind of thing happening when he passed by the office. How could someone provoke Zhao An without knowing the consequences? When Principal Du thought about taking his anger out on him, his head was about to explode!
"What happened? There are no classes, what's wrong with these students?" Principal Du came over, still very majestic with a beer belly, and his eyes were a little unfriendly.

Now the teachers around were a little confused. Principal Du was very slippery, and he would not appear unless it was something important. And he holds a lot of power, basically everything needs to be approved by the principal.

"Principal, this classmate instigated other students to beat up classmates. This is extremely bad. If you don't teach them well, the nature of the future will become even worse!" Peng Ze's expression was a little stiff. At this point, he had no way out. One wrong step would lead to another. Even if it was wrong, he had to hold on for the sake of face.
Principal Du looked at Zhao An's calm expression. No matter whether it was true or not, he beat him because he had a background. What's wrong? You're still not convinced, right?
"Let's ask about this matter first, Director Lin, I'll leave it to you to deal with it."

This was named in person. The former director of teaching had been arrested, and the person who took over was Principal Du's own man. The deputy director was vacant, and naturally it was Lin Cui who proposed to Zhao An.

As for the relationship between Lin Cui and Zhao An, whether there was a physical relationship besides teacher and student, Principal Du didn't know and didn't want to know. It is better not to be too curious about some things, as this will not bring good results to yourself.
"I know, I will handle this matter." Lin Cui nodded, "Zhao An, tell me what happened."

Zhao An talked about the past casually, without exaggerating or belittling the other party. There was no need for that. He had to get angry on the spot. There was plenty of time to deal with the other party.

"This is what happened. I am wondering, what's your business that I am using a notebook? Did it bother you? And why do you say I don't have a father? I hope classmate Wei Hao can give me an explanation, otherwise I will hire a lawyer."
"Wei Hao, is that so?" Peng Ze said with gritted teeth.

Wei Hao was a little scared, but after seeing his uncle's expression, he gritted his teeth and said, "No, I was joking with Zhao An, and he called people to beat me. He wanted to be the boss, this is violence! I want to go to the hospital!"
"I don't know whether you will go to the hospital, but you will definitely accept the accusation." Zhao An said lightly, "Call a few classmates to confront them and you will know."
Wei Hao was a little panicked now. He was wrong in the beginning, why did he provoke Zhao An for no reason?
Soon several classmates were called over, and the confessions they got were all that Wei Hao had provoked, and Zhao An did not say anything or fight back.

chapters.title: Chapter 52 You should quit!
paragraphs: The matter is very clear at this point, it is Wei Hao who deliberately provoked.

Peng Ze's expression was already very bad. He glared at his nephew angrily, and then added, "Okay, this is Wei Hao who deliberately insulted his classmates, and he should be punished. But Zhao An, you asked senior students to bully junior students. What should be done about this matter?"

"Hey, Teacher Peng, I was not called by Zhao An. It was this guy who spit at me today. Such an uncivilized thing, I remembered it and beat him up in a moment of excitement. I apologize." Lin Qingsong took all the responsibilities, and his intention to be Zhao An's lackey was obvious.

Peng Ze's expression was not very good. It was obvious that he was called by Zhao An to beat someone up, so he looked very angry, "Lin Qingsong, you have to think it through. Beating someone is wrong. You have to pay for it. You may still be punished and be placed on probation!"
Lin Qingsong nodded, "I'm telling the truth. I'll put him on probation. I just don't like him. It's okay for him to spit at me, but it's not okay for me to beat him up?"
Zhao An sneered at this time, "Haha, I'll pay for Lin Qingsong's medical expenses. Okay. What's going on, Teacher Lin, you know it, right?"
This tone didn't sound like the attitude of talking to a teacher at all, and no one noticed it.

Lin Cui nodded, "Okay, Teacher Peng, I think you misunderstood. Lin Qingsong hit someone, and he was punished with a serious offense. Wei Hao insulted his classmates and was punished with a serious offense. Don't let this happen again next time. Also, Wei Hao apologizes to Zhao An, now, immediately!"
After these words, it was the final word, and no one else could help.
Peng Ze's expression became very ugly, and Wei Hao was a little scared. He nodded timidly, "I'm sorry, Zhao An. I was wrong, please forgive me."
"Haha, I forgive you? Our business is not over yet, if there is nothing else, I will leave first." Zhao An closed the notebook and sneered at Wei Hao. The other party was dead!
"Teacher Peng, you are biased well. I didn't expect a teacher to be able to do this. Your uncle-nephew relationship is really hidden very deeply. Okay, I will tell the principal about this matter."
Peng Ze didn't know why, but his hands and feet were cold after hearing this.

Lin Cui shook her head and watched her man leave the office. "Hey, Mr. Peng, you are too impatient. You should investigate it before you draw a conclusion. Zhao An is a good student. Don't wrongly accuse a good student. You should take care of yourself."
This seemed to be a hidden meaning. Peng Ze felt that something bad was going to happen to him, and he felt a little bit like a disaster was coming.
Zhao An picked up the phone and called Bao Xiong. Bao Xiong should be Zhao An's number one lackey now, responsible for handling the dirty work.

Especially since all his handles were in Zhao An's hands, and he saw Zhao An talking and laughing with the person in charge of this area, as if he was high and mighty, Bao Xiong knew that he had to follow Zhao An's footsteps unswervingly. There was nothing wrong with being a dog. Being a dog was happy, and having money was enough.
After hearing Zhao An's instructions, Bao Xiong patted his chest and vowed to do a good job of this matter.

On the other side, Principal Du also called Peng Ze. In the principal's office, Principal Du smoked a cigarette and said in a heavy tone, "Teacher Peng, after feedback, some people said that you are biased towards students, which has caused extremely bad psychological effects on students. The Education Bureau wants you to resign on your own. They see that you are about to retire and don't want to make things difficult for you. You can say that you are resigning or other reasons are fine."
Peng Ze now completely understood why Zhao An was so fearless, "Principal, this, this is not good. I will retire in a year. If I resign, I will have no pension."

"This is not something I can decide. This is the intention of the superiors. You are so good, why do you provoke Zhao An?" Principal Du sneered. Peng Ze actually did something he didn't dare to do, and offended him all the time. He is really brave, worthy of being an old teacher.

Peng Ze was a little flustered, and could only hurriedly say, "I didn't target him, because three students beat up one student at that time, and the situation was urgent, principal, I really didn't target him."

"I don't know about this, I just conveyed the order. If you don't resign voluntarily, you can only wait for the Education Bureau to issue a notice to officially dismiss you. If you leave on your own, you can still save face, but if you are dismissed, you will lose face. Make your own choice!" Principal Du announced coldly, killing an ordinary teacher, what's that?

Peng Ze's face turned red with anger, and he couldn't even laugh at this moment. He wanted to say something harsh, but he suddenly sighed, "Principal, my son's situation is not very good. I need this pension to reduce the burden. Can you please help me run it?"

"This is not my business. You should find the person involved to apologize, not me. Finding me will not have any effect. Do you understand? Old Peng, you said you are about to retire, and you are not good at other times. Why are you so angry today?" Principal Du shook his head. He had no ill will towards Peng Ze, and of course no good intentions. He just reminded him out of affection.
"Who? Zhao An?" Peng Ze asked doubtfully.
"Who else do you say?" Principal Du sneered.

After a class, Zhao An came to the podium, "Someone insulted me today. I am a person who holds grudges and will take revenge. You can rest assured about this. In addition, what I said is very important. After school this afternoon, everyone does not need to leave. I will invite everyone to have a meal at 6 o'clock. There are also teachers in the class. Students who want to go can sign up. It's okay if you don't want to go, just say it. Zhang Cuilian, if you are free, can you help me register? Everyone can just tell Zhang Cuilian. Tonight's dinner is my treat. There is no need to be polite as classmates."
"Really! Thank you!"
"Wow, there is something to eat?"
"Zhao An, you are so handsome, you are the most handsome!"
The flattery sounded. High school students are all very simple. It is of course a good thing to be treated by someone, and there are teachers going together.

Zhao An looked at the teacher in front of him with a playful look in his eyes, "Oh, really? You want me to forgive you?"
Peng Ze nodded, his expression somewhat sad and angry. It was a shame to bow to a student, but he had to bow his head, "Yes, Zhao An, please forgive me."

"I can't see your sincerity. How about this, you go back, don't you live in the classroom dormitory? Let your wife cook two dishes, accompany me to drink two glasses, I will forgive you if I am satisfied. By the way, remember to tell your wife about this matter, tell her exactly how you wronged me. Okay, I will go there after one class, whether you are sincere or not depends on you." Zhao An turned around and walked into the classroom after speaking, old teacher? Haha, old stubborn. It was fine at first, but he played himself into trouble!

Peng Ze was immediately excited when he heard that there was still a chance. He didn't know that he was already a little pitiful, and he didn't know what Zhao An's plan was, and he didn't intend to know. He just wanted to be forgiven so that he could beg the other party to keep his position.
Peng Ze quickly went back to find his wife Wang Huifang and told her everything.

Wang Huifang was a typical rural woman. She was not the kind of honest and decent one, but she was fierce and snobbish like a rural woman, greedy for cheapness and a little timid. The only thing that impressed Zhao An was that the other party's laughter was very hearty, very much like an aunt.

"Old Peng, how did you provoke him? He is a student, and we invite him to drink. Is this appropriate?" Wang Huifang said with some concern. When she heard that Zhao An's background was still very vague, and she only knew that there was someone above her, she was extremely flustered.

"How should I know? Humph, it's all because of your relatives. I saw him being beaten, so I must have shouted. Now, I've lost my job because of him." Peng Ze began to complain helplessly, blaming his wife and everyone else.
Wang Huifang was unhappy, "Blame me? Your son's matter still depends on the help of my relatives, humph, now you're turning your back on me?"

Peng Ze smiled awkwardly, "You go cook, try to make delicious food, now we can only stabilize Zhao An, stabilize Zhao An, then we have a chance. Otherwise, when the time comes, our son will have no money to support us in our old age, and we will be miserable."
Wang Huifang also knew that this was not the time to be upset, so she twisted her big butt to cook.
After a class, which happened to be a chemistry class, Lin Cui smiled and said "get out of class dismissed".

Recently, Lin Cui has been moistened by Zhao An's semen. She looks much younger, with a mature woman's charm blooming. She looked at Zhao An with her beautiful eyes. She was still busy. She didn't care what Zhao An was doing. Her class would definitely not embarrass her man.
"Teacher, I will treat you to dinner tonight. If you have nothing to do, let's go together." Zhao An smiled and said, "I invited all the classmates."
Lin Cui nodded, "Okay, I will go."

I found the head teacher to ask for leave. Originally, the head teacher was reluctant to approve the leave for students, but after seeing that it was Zhao An, he was a little unsure, so he approved it. First, find out about Zhao An's background, and then see. If there is no background, then I won't give it to him in the future. If there is a background, then there is no problem in giving the green light. This is the privilege of the children of rich and powerful people.
I came to the second-floor dormitory on the west side. Teacher Peng Ze's dormitory is here.

Zhao An pushed the door open and walked in, looking familiar with the place. He saw a big and strong rural woman cooking. She was more than 1.5 meters tall and wore a pair of slippers. She was wearing an apron at the moment, and the most attractive thing was her big buttocks, which were very eye-catching. She was a typical rural woman, with healthy wheat-colored skin from years of hard work and no loose skin.
Peng Ze immediately stood up and greeted her with a smile, "Hello, classmate Zhao An, please sit down. I have prepared my own wine for you, please sit down and you can taste it."
"I don't drink, you drink. Is that your lover?" Zhao An's eyes flashed with a gleam of brilliance, and he seemed to be a little eager to make a move.
Peng Ze nodded and responded with a smile, "Yes, this is my lover Wang Huifang, an old woman."

"Old woman? I don't think so. She looks quite young. Let's stop talking nonsense. I invited the teachers and classmates of our class to have dinner at the big hotel tonight. Whether you can go depends on your sincerity. And you are also an old teacher. Your son's life is very difficult, right? He lost a lot of money in business and you have to pay for it. Haha, it's really miserable. If you can satisfy me, I will talk to the people below and let you retire as deputy director. The retirement salary is much higher than that of an ordinary teacher like you." Zhao An sneered, looking at Wang Huifang's big butt, an evil plan is rising.

Peng Ze was happy, but he knew that there is no free lunch in the world. The other party has already found out their family situation. What does this show? It shows that Zhao An is not an ordinary student. At the same time, he is still showing his strength and can easily play with them.
